items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Quantum
items.detail: Get from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Build a Generator in a C.A.M.P. or Workshop
items.detail: Open C.A.M.P. build menu, navigate to Power and place any Generator.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to a vendor.

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center.

items.title: Eat a box of Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese
items.detail: Find one at Grafton Dam rowboat or Watoga Underground diner.

items.title: Kill a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center for reliable spawns.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter Shelter, access build menu, select Decorations category.

items.title: Buy an item from or Sell an item to another Player
items.detail: Visit another player's C.A.M.P. and use their vendor.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted items to vendors at train stations.

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Public events spawn server-wide every 20 minutes.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Check Pip-Boy map for gray cloudy areas and clear the infestation.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town; Slasher appears during the final stage.

items.title: Kill a Legendary Creature
items.detail: Join public events like Radiation Rumble or Uranium Fever.

items.title: Kill a Mutated Enemy
items.detail: Join Mutated Public Events that start on the hour with green hexagon icon.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Pint-Sized Phantoms can take over Infestations; kill them inside the hotspot.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Mutated enemies appear in public events on the hour, offering special rewards from Mutated Party Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience points are doubled, allowing players to level up faster and maximize scoreboard progression.

events.name: World Pets Update
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and starting Season 27 You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event combines with double mutation effects for enhanced rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed scorched enemies appear with festive gifts and waterlogged gift rewards.
